data.one_liner: Builds a vertical column where text wraps around floated widgets, similar to CSS float.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FloatColumn widget and Floatable elements that allow text, RichText, and WrappableText to flow around left- or right-aligned widgets. It supports clearing floats, padding, margins, first-line indents, and text selection.
use_when: You need CSS-style float and clear layouts in Flutter apps.
You want text to wrap around embedded images, logos, or drop caps.
avoid_when: You only need standard linear vertical and horizontal stacking (standard Column and Row suffice).
strengths: Works with Flutter text selection and screen reader accessibility.
weaknesses: Does not replace complex grid layouts (use staggered grid instead).

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you need complex multi-column grid layouts rather than CSS-like inline text floating.
